issues.description: Behavior change: empty base_image now defaults to python:3.12 instead of KFP default
issues.detail: In pipeline.py the fallback in `_set_base_image` changed from `""` (which the template treated as 'use kfp default') to a hard-coded `python:3.12`. This silently changes runtime behavior for users who relied on the KFP default image and may break pipelines depending on packages present in the previous default. Should be documented or feature-flagged.

issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE duplicated in three places, risking drift
issues.detail: `python:3.12` is now hard-coded in `backend/kale/pipeline.py`, the Jinja template fallback `nb_function_template.jinja2`, the TS `Commands.getDefaultBaseImage` catch fallback, and `CellMetadataEditor.tsx` as `DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE`. When the backend default changes, frontends will silently diverge. Centralize or fetch the value from a single source.

issues.description: IMAGE button gives no visual cue when a custom base image is set
issues.detail: The previous Input showed the current `baseImage` inline. The new compact button labeled 'IMAGE' shows no indication whether a custom image is configured for the step; users must open the dialog to verify. Consider badging the button or changing its color/label when `props.baseImage` is non-empty.

issues.description: Button width: '5%' is likely ineffective and inconsistent with sibling styles
issues.detail: `style={{ width: '5%' }}` on the MUI Button inside a flex row likely won't render a meaningful width and conflicts with the wrapper's 30%/width split used for the Select. The previous Input used 25%. Pick a layout strategy consistent with neighbors to avoid alignment regressions.

issues.description: Dialog input placeholder logic doesn't reflect 'Reset to Default' semantics clearly
issues.detail: The placeholder cascades `pipelineBaseImage || defaultBaseImage || DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE`, but the 'Default:' label above only shows `defaultBaseImage`. When a pipeline-level base image exists, users may be confused why the default shown differs from the placeholder. Consider showing both, or clarifying which value 'Reset to Default' restores.

issues.description: Local import inside RPC function is unnecessary and inconsistent
issues.detail: `get_default_base_image` does `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside the function. Other RPCs in this module import at module scope. Move the import to the top of `rpc/nb.py` for consistency and to avoid repeated lookup cost on every RPC call.

review.summary: The PR cleanly threads a configurable default base image from backend to UI, but it has one substantive behavior change (empty base_image is no longer treated as KFP default) and a duplication problem: `python:3.12` is now hard-coded in four locations across Python and TypeScript, defeating the purpose of a single source of truth. The new IMAGE button is less informative than the inline Input it replaces, and minor styling/layout concerns in the dialog deserve a pass. No P0 blockers.
